title: Moving Beyond Medical Exam Questions: A Clinician-Annotated Dataset of Real-World Tasks and Ambiguity in Mental Healthcare

bias_targets.methodology: Varying patient gender variables (female, male, non-binary) in clinical scenario prompts and comparing language model decision-making accuracy across these groups.
Substituting patient ethnicity variables (African American, Native American, White, Black, Asian, Hispanic) in clinical scenario prompts and measuring the impact on model accuracy.
Substituting patient age variables across different age brackets (18-33, 33-49, 49-65 years) in clinical scenario prompts and evaluating changes in model decision-making accuracy.
